sections.text:
[Effects]
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by L.
Recovers 5 Cost.
Restores 5% of damage dealt as HP.
Ability Power scales with the number of Dark elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of 4XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
M
Activation rate scales with the number of Dark elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).
